caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork quilt composed of several irregularly shaped fabric segments, each adorned with embroidery in floral patterns. The quilt pieces are colored in shades of beige, brown, black, green, red, maroon, grey, and light blue, with each segment outlined and connected by zigzag and decorative stitched borders in various colors including yellow, blue, and white. Different sections feature clusters of stylized flowers and leaves: in the top left is a group of red flowers with green stems, while the center contains a green patch with red and pink flowers and yellow leaves. The upper right segment displays yellow flowers on a brown background, and multiple other patches are decorated with flowers in purples, blues, oranges, and whites. The embroidery threads are used in a variety of colors to highlight each floral design and to indicate veins, stems, and other botanical details. The quilt’s edges feature visible stitch patterns and a multi-colored woven border on the left. The entire artwork gives a multi-faceted appearance with layered, intersecting patches and floral motifs on each, rendered with precise and vivid embroidery work.
title: Crazy Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
